messages:
alex: Quick sync — we're building the runbook for next Tues' webinar + launch post + benchmark narrative. Saw a keyword spike for "low-latency inference". Need tech SEO tasks: redirects for legacy posts, schema on webinar + landing, internal-link map, and inbound routing for demo requests. Can we triage?

maria: Copying. I'll own keywords + structured data. Do we want Event schema + FAQ schema for the webinar page?

sam: I'll finish the launch post draft today. Q: do we canonicalize old blog -> new benchmark URL? I can update links if so. Also planning a case study section linking to the webinar signup.

jordan: I can own redirects and meta headers. Send me the mapping (old path -> new path + status). Will need the CSV.

liz: I'll wire HubSpot routing. For demo signups from the webinar funnel: hidden field `webinar_source` and route to SDR queue `webinar-ttl`. Also add UTM handling so we can attribute.

alex: @maria yes Event + FAQ + Organization markup. Also need OG image variations for social and benchmark card. Can you paste minimal required fields for Event?

maria: Minimal Event fields: name, startDate, endDate (if multi-day), url, description. For FAQ use mainEntity with question/answer pairs. Example snippet: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org", "@type":"Event", "name":"Low-latency Inference webinar", "startDate":"2026-04-07T10:00:00Z", "url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/low-latency"}
```
I'll also add Organization markup on the site header.

jordan: Redirect plan draft: `/blog/latency` -> `/benchmark/latency-2026` (301), `/old-webinar` -> `/webinars/low-latency` (302 until 2026-04-15). I'll upload CSV to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/redirects/latency-q2.csv

seo-bot: crawl_report: 12 warnings on schema missing `startDate` on /webinars/low-latency; 3 broken internal links found under /benchmark.

sam: Noted the broken links in my draft. I'll replace `/docs/perf` with `/docs/benchmarks` and add anchor links to the Takeaways section.

liz: Routing QA note: we need server-side redirect to preserve utm params for HubSpot. @jordan can you ensure redirect preserves query strings?

jordan: Yes — using nginx redirects that preserve query strings. Sample: 
```nginx
rewrite ^/blog/latency$ /benchmark/latency-2026 permanent;
# frontend preserves query string through $request_uri
proxy_pass http://frontend$request_uri;
```
I'll confirm on staging.

maria: Also recommend internal linking map: landing -> benchmark -> deep-dive -> docs -> signup. That flow helps anchor link equity and funnel users to the CTA. I'll sketch and share a Notion page.

alex: Timeline proposal: schema + redirects by EOD Thu, OG + launch post by Fri, routing QA Mon. Analytics needs custom event `webinar_reg_source` for funnel attribution. Any blockers?

liz: I'll create GA4 event and HubSpot property. Will add GTM trigger and share preview. cc @sam for the GTM step.

sam: I'll add a dataLayer push on sign-up button: 
```js
dataLayer.push({event:'webinar_signup', webinar:'low-latency', source: getUTM()});
```
and include microcopy for the signup form.

maria: After schema is live, I'll re-run Rich Results/Structured Data test and confirm zero warnings. Will also re-check FAQ markup passes.

alex: Great. Small follow-ups: canonical header owner? @jordan. Final content QA: @sam + @maria. Thanks everyone :rocket:

jordan: Assigned. Will update CSV + deploy redirects to staging tonight and ping when ready.

sam: Draft pushed: https://content.redwood.ai/drafts/latency-benchmark-v3 — updated internal links and added CTA anchor. Please review.

maria: Reviewed, left 3 inline comments on keyword density and FAQ phrasing. One suggestion: emphasize 'latency per token' metric in H2s.

liz: Scheduling a routing + analytics QA slot Mon 9am PT. Invite sent.

alex: Perfect. If anything urgent ping here. We'll run a post-launch check on Wed to confirm redirects & schema in search console.

jordan: Will run Search Console fetch + sitemap resubmit after deploy.

sam: Thanks — will iterate on copy after @maria comments.

maria: I'll re-run the structured data tester once redirects are live to catch any URL mismatches.

liz: Adding this to the launch checklist — milestone flags: redirects(done), schema(ready), OG(done), routing(QA).

alex: Closing loop — we'll reconvene in the QA slot. :thumbsup:
